## Concept gate

Before writing the full manuscript, provide three treatments of roughly 150–250 words. Each treatment includes a working title, opening, main movement, ending and one representative paragraph.

- [ ] Treatment A reviewed
- [ ] Treatment B reviewed
- [ ] Treatment C reviewed
- **Selected or combined direction:**
- **Selected by (owner or assigned editor, not the chapter author):**
- **Decision date:**
- [ ] Selection recorded before full manuscript production
- [ ] Editor completed the early structure pass

The selected treatment approves copy direction only. It does not approve factual claims, final prose, publication, illustrations or quiz content.

## Manuscript and learning alignment

- [ ] Content pass establishes claims, sources, decisions and evidence boundaries
- [ ] Copy pass establishes hierarchy, flow, transitions, pace and readability for the named reader
- [ ] Supporting example advances the argument without becoming the subject
- [ ] Relevant surrounding chapters and the chapter that introduced the selected through-line were read
- [ ] Figure explains a central relationship, or omission is recorded with a reason
- [ ] Quiz tests decisions or distinctions taught by the final prose
- [ ] Title, summary, curriculum map, index and navigation agree
- [ ] Editor completed the prose-and-alignment pass

## Completion checks

- [ ] Preview validation passes on the complete editorial change set
- [ ] Owner review finds no unresolved audience, thesis or example-role change
- [ ] Release validation passes on the clean committed revision
- [ ] Publication authorization, deployment and live verification are recorded separately
